summary: Duplicate workflow role IDs are rejected with a validation error.

evidence: On current main, registering a workflow with a repeated role ID returned 409 Resource already exists from workflow_roles_pkey. Updating with a repeated role ID returned 500 Failed to update workflow because that IntegrityError is caught in update_workflow. Both paths now return 422 with detail role_ids contains duplicate references, matching forms, and do not write the duplicate grant. ./test.sh tests/e2e/api/test_register_workflow.py -v passed 12 tests after the change. ./test.sh quality api reported pyright 0 errors and ruff clean.
